description: Timeline view zooms in while the line rises in frame (line y about 98 -> 47 in tile px), ticks spread apart and the three cavemen grow about 25%. Label "100,000 BC" and caption "Your ancestor" with curved arrow still present.

Zoom continues onto the centre bone-hairband caveman; head width roughly 75 (f615) -> 95 (f616) -> 130 (f617) -> 155 (f618) -> 160 (f619) tile px: fast accelerating then settling by f618-f619. Reads as continuous zoom, not a cut.

Timeline line, label and "Your ancestor" caption leave the top/left of frame as the zoom passes (caption cut at left edge in f615, gone in f616); neighbouring old and grumpy cavemen are pushed off the left and right edges by f616-f617.

Right-hand panel (couch figure with phone, snacks) slides in from the right: black vertical divider moves leftwards each frame (tile x about 400, 370, 337, 305, 283, 265, 253, 245 for f723-f730), decelerating. Iced drink first visible in f726.
Left-panel caveman shrinks about 0.75x (head width ~160 -> ~120 tile px) so more of the legs show; hairy feet first visible at bottom edge f725 and fully in view by f727.
Background goes from mid grey (f844) through darker greys (f845-f847) to near black (f848) while the face art stays unchanged; a thin dark vertical line at the far left present only in f844.
Black background hold; face, bloodshot eyes and whipped-cream corner essentially static (head moves only a few tile px).

Whole caption "but here is the thing" is already complete in f940 (no letter-by-letter reveal visible) and scales up about 1.45x (width ~205 -> ~295 tile px), decelerating; vertical position nearly constant.
Caption holds at its enlarged size.
Timeline row with five cavemen and label "100,000 BC" is static (label at tile x~243 in all three frames).

Row scrolls leftwards at increasing speed: label x 243 -> 187 (f1048) -> 73 (f1049) -> out of frame (f1050+). The row then shows a longer repeated cast (happy, grumpy, old figures recurring); frame-to-frame jump between f1048 and f1049 is large.

Fast horizontal scroll of a repeating row of text-face stick figures under ticks (spacing ~100 tile px); no label visible. Direction not determinable (pattern repeats, temporal aliasing). Line moves from tile y~107 (f1088-f1091) to the same height in the lower row, so no vertical move.

Cutout bearded man creeps in from the left edge: head x about 0-60 (f1176-f1179) to 25-85 (f1183) tile px, ~8 tile px per frame with slight bob; arms are thin black lines. Meadow, tree, skeleton static (static camera).
Man tumbles forward: body tilted about 45 degrees in f1256-f1257, drops and flattens, head reaches the skeleton skull at f1259. Whole figure moves as one rigid cutout.
Red blood marks appear at the nose at f1259 (first frame of contact) and persist through f1263.
Man lies on skull with small jitter: head offsets a few px per frame, thin arm line swings (horizontal in f1262). Camera static.
Man stands centre-left, arms hanging down; forest/boulder static.
Arms jump to raised "V" pose at f1381 (one-frame pose swap, no in-betweens seen) then waver and drift slightly right through f1385. Camera static.

Painterly saber-tooth cat enters from the left bottom edge (partly cropped f1417), moves right and upward in an arc (head y about 190 -> 110 tile px) with changing crouch/leap poses each frame, ~25-35 tile px per frame; man stays right of it with arms up.

Small motion only: baby shifts left toward the patient (about 25 tile px), doctor and patient heads shift a few px; torch flame shape differs frame to frame. Sign, bed, window, rug do not move visibly.
Baby lies on patient chest; doctor drifts slightly right/forward and patient head moves a few px; flame varies. Camera static.
Row of tick-mounted bearded and ginger figures scrolls quickly; direction not determinable (repeating pattern aliasing).
A small text-face figure appears in the row at f1602-f1603 amid the bearded figures (cast changes from bearded/ginger to text-face).

Timeline row of bone-hairband cavemen scrolls rightwards about 55 tile px per frame (tick x 70 -> 131 -> 185 ...), new figures entering from the left edge; grey-haired old caveman enters at f1646-f1647.
Teacher behind stone lectern sways head by a few tile px; chalk formula, poster, sign and desks unchanged (static camera). Mostly NO_VISIBLE_CHANGE otherwise.

Teacher stands higher/left of lectern with torso and leaf loincloth visible; thin orange pointer swings from low-left (f2098) to up-left (f2099-f2100) and near-vertical against the formula (f2101-f2105). Camera static.
Whole caption "to never being born at all" present from f2227 (no reveal seen) and scales up slowly (width ~325 -> ~355 tile px), baseline unchanged.
Caption continues slow scale-up (~380 -> ~393 tile px), slower per-frame growth than f2227-f2234.

Close-up board and teacher: board content shifts rightwards a few px per frame (chalk "deadliest periods" left end x 0 -> ~10, sign x 380 -> ~390 tile px), with slight scale-up; text is already present on frame 1, not typed on.
Pan continues and the chalk numeral "5" before "deadliest periods" has moved into view at the left edge (x~0-12 in f2304 to ~10-25 in f2311): revealed by camera move, not by drawing.
Pointer stick leaves its low horizontal rest (f2304-f2309) and tilts upward at f2310-f2311; teacher head and torso rise slightly across the strip, leaf loincloth edge appears lower left.

Two-line text "20,000 years ago" slides off the right frame edge: only the left part visible (x~355-480 in f2776, ~385-480 f2777, ~418-480 f2778, ~450-480 f2779), left end last to leave, gone by f2780.
Globe grows about 1.5x (diameter ~160 -> ~240 tile px) while its centre drifts rightwards toward frame centre (x 158 -> 232).
At f2783 a faint off-white rectangular halo appears around the globe and linework looks heavier/painted; cause (layer or image swap) not determinable.
Globe with large white ice cap and scalloped icicle edge held static (tile x ~108-358).
Hard cut at f2835 from whole globe to extreme close-up of an ice slab with hanging icicles over blue water and a green land edge at lower right; no in-between scale frames seen.
Close-up ice slab holds static.
Teacher in wide classroom shot bobs/sways a few tile px (head y ~105-130); pointer rests low and faint; board list "North America / Europe / Asia" (three indented lines) unchanged; camera static.
Pointer rises from low horizontal at the left (f2954-f2955) to diagonal toward the board lines (f2956-f2957), held by a thin black arm.
Pointer tip touches the end of "Asia" (f2958), swings up past "Europe" (f2959) and reaches near-vertical beside the text (f2960-f2961).
Small thermometer icon (blue mercury, six ticks) near x~225 tile px; no text yet; icon begins drifting left (225 -> 218).

"10 F (6 C)" label (with raised degree glyphs) is revealed left to right by a hard clip edge: only "10 F" visible in f3127, up to "(6 C" with the ")" clipped in f3128, complete in f3129. The first characters ("1","0") appear first; text itself does not move.

Icon (not text) slides left about 8-11 tile px per frame (x 225 -> 162) while the label stays at x~222, opening a gap between icon and label; icon moves as a rigid asset. Mercury stays blue throughout the strip.

Small caveman at left on the lake shore bobs vertically (~10 tile px) with black stick arms changing angle; glacier background shows no clear camera change across the 8 frames (any slow zoom not resolvable here).

Push-in on the caveman: head width ~65 -> ~110 tile px over 8 frames (about 1.7x), cliffs and trees in the background also scale; head moves toward frame centre; mouth/eyes read from smile (f3366) to flatter expression (f3371-f3373).
Frost-covered caveman shivers: small squiggle marks beside his arm and the squinting face change shape every frame. Snow hills, rock, tree and clouds look static within the 8 frames.
Same shiver loop (squiggle marks and scrunched face vary per frame); background static in this window; the slow state-level push reported by earlier reviewers is not resolvable in 8 frames.
